name: Mirae Asset Life Insurance Co., Ltd.
summary: Mirae Asset Life Insurance Co., Ltd. operates in the South Korean market, delivering a diverse portfolio of financial protection offerings. These include various life and personal insurance policies, reinsurance contracts, and a selection of retirement planning solutions. By the end of 2019, the company maintained an extensive network comprising 41 branches and 104 agencies. Established in 1988, its central operations are based in Seoul, South Korea.
